dimensions.battlefield_command: perceived ability to command troops in battle
dimensions.logistics: perceived ability to sustain forces and movement
dimensions.discipline: perceived ability to maintain order and standards
dimensions.contract_reliability: perceived fulfillment of agreements and paid obligations
dimensions.honor: audience-specific perception of honorable conduct under its norms
dimensions.mercy: perceived willingness to spare/treat defeated people leniently
dimensions.cruelty: perceived willingness to inflict unnecessary or exemplary harm
dimensions.political_danger: perceived threat to offices, factions, dynastic interests, or autonomy
dimensions.commercial_reliability: perceived reliability in trade, payment, transport, storage, and commercial obligations
dimensions.wealth_patronage: perceived access to wealth and ability to reward followers/patrons

rule: Dimensions are audience beliefs, not objective stats. Omit unsupported dimensions instead of filling neutral values.
